answer: Persistent workload ledger. Each identity must continuously publish verifiable compute receipts to a shared ocean of task queues; rewards accrue only from sustained, non-duplicated work histories. Cloning forces an attacker to forge a parallel receipt stream, and reconciliation checks cross-validate timing and resource signatures. A saffron-tagged audit trail flags correlated submission patterns. Per-clone cost: maintaining independent compute plus audit penalties exceeding honest participation.
